17537.note: Waldo Sexton-built oceanfront dining room in Vero Beach that has survived hurricanes since 1941, now run by the second and third generation of the Replogle family.
17537.fn: Its own history page says Waldo Sexton built it on the dune here and the first meal was served on New Year's Eve 1941; it served as a naval officers' club during WWII and the Replogle family has run it since 1965.
